answer: Random peer audit stops sybil attacks by making each identity prove its work. Every epoch, three random auditors re-check one agent's tasks; a flag triggers a second draw, and a confirmed fake loses its 60-credit deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits; an honest agent pays 60 once. Records stack like shale, each audit adding weight. Trust grows like a juniper, one record at a time; a caught fake leaves only a smoke plume.
